name: vggt_presentation
description: Interactive Streamlit simulations and presentation materials exploring VGGT (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer, CVPR 2025 Best Paper Award). Features browser-based monocular and multi-view 3D reconstruction demos using simplified heuristics for educational purposes, plus slides and AI-generated explainers.

paragraphs: Educational Demonstrations of Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT, CVPR 2025)

This repository contains my Master's coursework project exploring the VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (CVPR 2025) paper through an academic presentation and interactive Streamlit-based simulations.

These demos simulate VGGT's impressive capabilities in monocular and multi-view 3D reconstruction using simplified heuristics (e.g., brightness-based depth cues and synthetic camera poses) to create engaging, browser-based 3D visualizations. They are designed for educational purposes and do not run the actual VGGT model.
features: Interactive Web Demos via Streamlit: Explore simulated 3D point clouds in your browser.
Monocular demo on a single artistic oil painting 🎨
Multi-view demo fusing 8 room images (even with no overlap) 🏠
Adjustable parameters: Point density, depth intensity, field of view.
Presentation assets: Slides (Excalidraw source + PDF), NotebookLM-generated explainer video & podcast.
